summary: CWE-535: The bad() entry point wrote the username and session ID to the process error stream (System.err via an OutputStreamWriter/PrintWriter). Error-stream output can surface in shell/console error channels and expose sensitive data such as the session identifier. The fix preserves the feature (validate the username, create/retrieve the session, and record the username+session diagnostic message) but routes the diagnostic through the application's controlled logger (IO.logger) instead of the error output stream. Username validation and the invalid-character response path are unchanged.

HttpSession session = request.getSession(true);
